summary: Frontend-only regression for the Admin Panel redesign (/admin) on mobile viewport (390x844). All 15 acceptance points from the review request verified end-to-end via Playwright. Dashboard shows Users=6, Pending=3 (₹85.00), Paid=3 (₹60.00). Manage chip row exposes users/payout/livectrl/config/settings. Users search narrows list (typing '9876' hides u2..u6 and keeps u1). User Details sheet opens/closes, password reveal toggle, editable fields, save toast, activity/payouts subtab swap, and delete-confirm dialog (OK toasts and closes sheet) all work. Payout Approve/Reject flows show the confirm dialog (cancel + OK paths verified), reject accepts a reason and toasts, payout avatar opens user sheet, and UPI copy fires. LiveCtrl banner toggles + add work; empty push shows error toast, filled push shows success toast (real notification pushed via addCustomNotification). Config has all 7 checkin inputs, 9 per-game reward inputs, wallet ratio, chip add/delete. Settings shows 12 maintenance toggles (global + home + wallet + 9 games), force-update toggle/version/message, slide-menu label/icon/url with add/delete. Confirm dialog Cancel and OK both wired. No red-screen or console errors observed. Backend testing skipped per request.

issues: Close ('admin-user-close') sits at the top of the sheet and can be transiently covered by an in-app toast (e.g. after approve/reject navigation) — clicks blocked until the toast dismisses. Consider raising the close button z-index above the toast or rendering the toast below the modal header.

action_items: Optional: split /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx (877 lines) into per-tab subcomponents (users, payout, livectrl, config, settings) — currently exceeds the 700-line guideline.
Optional design polish: ensure the toast layer does not obscure the sheet close button; either move the toast below the modal or bump the close icon's z-index/hit area.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx is 877 lines; consider extracting UsersTab / PayoutTab / LiveCtrlTab / ConfigTab / SettingsTab and UserDetailsSheet / ConfirmDialog into their own files under src/components/admin/.
SubTabs / EditField helpers use 'any' for styles+colors; typing them will preserve intellisense and prevent style regressions.
EditField uses defaultValue with no state binding, so edits inside Name/Mobile are visual only (matches the UI-only spec, but worth documenting so the field-value isn't relied on for the save toast).
No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used). Clipboard uses expo-clipboard (current).
seed_data_creation: None — Admin panel uses local mock data from src/constants/admin-mock.ts (users u1..u6, payouts p1a/p2a/p3a etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Panel is served at /admin (public URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). All testIDs listed in the request exist and are tappable. Mocked APIs: save/approve/reject/delete/config/settings actions only fire toasts; the notification push in LiveCtrl → Notification is the only real state mutation (adds to in-app custom notifications via useApp().addCustomNotification).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only a minor UX overlap between the toast layer and the user-details sheet close button, which can be reproduced by opening a user sheet immediately after a toast is shown; it self-resolves once the toast dismisses.
